# Build on Komms

Komms Publish, Komms RPC and the protocol for builders. Coming after launch.

*Updated 21 October 2026*

> [!NOTE]
> **Coming soon.** Developer tools arrive after launch. **[Join the developer waitlist](https://komms.app/?intent=builder&src=docs-developers#start)** to hear first.

## Komms Publish

Register your own content type, build your own app, and let the Komms network order, index, store and serve your content. The same proofs that protect Komms messages protect your app's data.

## Komms RPC

Paid access to Kaspa nodes run by Komms miners, scored for availability, speed and correctness. Built for wallets, explorers, apps and AI agents.

## The protocol

Komms is designed as one protocol under many apps. The flagship Komms app comes first; licensing the same backend to other apps follows. See the [Roadmap](../network/roadmap.md).

## Talk to us

Building something that needs private, verifiable communication? Email [info@komms.app](mailto:info@komms.app).
